description: Systèmes d'Informations des Ouvrages Hydrauliques is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by datara.gouv.fr. These data identify the position of the structures (dams and dikes) classified under the regulations on the safety of hydaulic structures in the department of Cantal. The data relating to each work can be found in the linked file. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Hydraulic Works Information Systems" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Gestion de crise, Restreint, Services de l'Etat. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
